modules.title: Leads and opportunities
modules.desc: Turn leads and opportunities on or off for the workspace or for each company.

email.title: Email
email.desc: How long the text of sent CRM emails is kept.

telephony.title: Telephony
telephony.desc: Calling from CRM records and logging calls as activities.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Settings used by CRM dashboards and reports.

modules.defaultHelp: Used by every company that inherits.
modules.companiesHelp: A company can follow the workspace default or turn a module on or off for itself.
modules.searchHint: Filter by company name or code.
modules.loadFailed: Could not load the company settings.
modules.leadsHelp: When off, companies that inherit hide the Leads pages and cannot add leads. Existing leads stay saved.
modules.opportunitiesHelp: When off, companies that inherit hide opportunities and cannot add new ones. Existing ones stay saved.
modules.requireQualified: Require a qualified stage before converting
modules.requireQualifiedHelp: Only leads in a stage that means Qualified can be converted.
modules.confirmDefaultOffText: {{n}} companies follow the default and will lose {{module}}: their pages are hidden and no one can add or edit records. Existing records stay saved.
modules.confirmCompanyOffText: Its pages are hidden in {{company}} and no one there can add or edit records. Existing records stay saved.
modules.confirmCompanyOffOpportunitiesNote: Turning off opportunities also stops lead conversion from creating one.

conflict.title: Company settings changed
conflict.text: Someone changed the company settings. Reload to see the latest, or keep yours and save again.

email.retentionHint: Between 30 and 2555 days. After that the message text is removed and only the sending record stays.

reports.timeZoneHint: Set by the platform. Dates in dashboards and reports use this zone.

retention.title: Email content retention
retention.description: Manage how long outbound email message content is kept.
retention.hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days. After that the message text is removed and only the sending record stays.

conflict.title: Retention setting changed
conflict.text: Someone changed this setting. Reload to see the latest value, or keep yours and save again.

telephony.summaryFailed: Could not load the phone summary.
telephony.clickToCallHint: When on, a phone icon next to a number calls it from the built-in phone. When off, it opens your computer's calling app.
telephony.logCallsHint: Adds a Call activity to the lead or customer after each call made from or matched to their record.

validation.range: Must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
validation.retentionRange: Must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}} days.
validation.websocketUrl: Enter a valid WebSocket URL starting with ws:// or wss://.
validation.reasonCode: Start with A–Z and use only A–Z, 0–9 or _ (2 to 64 characters).
